announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.intro: An announcement appears as a pop-up in the platform. You choose how it looks and see on the right, while you write, how it will look on a computer and on a phone. You enter the content here. Whoever dismisses it has read it: it then sits in Messages and does not come back.
announcements.bodyHint: Plain text, paragraphs with a blank line. Up to 1500 characters.
announcements.enHint: Without an English title and text, everyone sees the German one.
announcements.ctaHint: A path in the app, for example /connect, or an address starting with https://
announcements.showOnceHint: Shown once, even if someone does not click it away. Without the tick it comes back on every visit until it is clicked away.

results.invalid: Please fill in title and text. English only together (title and text), a button needs a label and a target, and the target a path or https://.

card.name: Card
card.hint: In the middle, the page pauses

banner.name: Banner
banner.hint: At the top, the page stays usable

explain.card: Card: the page waits until someone clicks. Good for important things everyone should read – use sparingly.
explain.banner: Banner: the page stays usable. The banner shows the title and the first sentence, “Read more” opens the whole text. It sits at the top and scrolls away with the page, until it is dismissed.
explain.toast: Notice: the page stays usable, the notice waits at the bottom right. On a phone, above the tabs.

announcements.showMeHint: “Show it to me” places the announcement on this page for you only, at real size. Nothing is published and nothing is recorded as seen.
